card.name: "and" in Indications and Usage references
card.fires_on: The word "and" inside the cross-reference "[see Indications and Usage (1.x)]" at the end of a label sentence. A weaker response appears partway through a few long words such as paracervical or the end of a drug name like palivizumab.

modes.description: The word "and" between "Indications" and "Usage" in a bracketed section cross-reference.

modes.label: Inside long medical words
modes.description: A middle piece of a long drug or anatomical term.

card.writes: It pushes toward word pieces and endings that continue a term, not toward the expected "Usage".
card.plain: It lights up on the "and" in the label cross-reference "see Indications and Usage".
